verdict.rationale: The evidence only mentions pipeline visibility and management in general terms ("Get complete visibility into your pipeline", "Advanced Forecast & Pipeline Management"). Nothing documents running multiple pipelines or configuring different stage sets per product or sales motion. Generic remarks about customizability do not establish this capability, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run multiple pipelines with different stage sets for different products or motions
